Low severity: step_id (FK to global steps table) is stored on ExecutionEvidence without checking it belongs to the org/execution's process. No read path was found that joins back to Step by this FK to display cross-org data (step_definition_id is only resolved against the execution's own execution_steps map, giving null on mismatch) -- so today it's a data-integrity gap, not a demonstrated read primitive. Flagging for record because it deviates from the pattern used elsewhere (e.g. InventoryRepository._assert_source_refs_belong_to_org) of validating FK org-ownership at write time.

Fix: added .join(Execution, ...).filter(..., Execution.org_id == self.org_id), matching sibling fix in add_step_order_connections in the same file.
